notes.title: Update 1.1.2: You can now join my Discord
notes.content:
Greetings.
I added a "Join Discord" button.
Also, this build was made with a new version of Unity which should bring better performance & stability.

notes.title: Update 1.1.1: Performance fix
notes.content:
Greetings!
I added a few fixes in this update. Here's the list:


 Fixed a performance degradation over time as the clouds didn't despawn.
 Reworked how clouds move.
 Fixed a campfire SFX bug.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0: Discard them cards!
notes.content:
Changes:


 Reworked the campfires. Sleeping now puts out the campfire and reduces the wood on the campfire.
 Cards can now be discarded (middle mouse click).

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 & 1.0.2
notes.content:
There was a typo on the Banana card.
 Fixed some faulty shield icons on cards which don't support carrying shields.
 Fixed a bug where the enemy would follow you across the bridge.

notes.title: Update 0.14.0: Going bananas with Bombs
notes.content:
Hey guys, this is a combined announcement for 0.13.1 and 0.14.0.
Things that have changed:

Fixed an inventory/card spawning bug.
Fixed 2 challenges which were previously locked by a bug.
Added new weapon "Bananarrr".
Added new food type "Banana".
Added new spell "Cannonball".
Reworked some card images.

notes.title: Update 0.13.0: New cards, new loot, new food
notes.content:
Greetings.
In this update, I made the following changes

Mobs now have a chance to drop loot
Increased the damage of the skeleton sword
Fixes related to picking up resources

notes.title: Update 0.12.0: Added tooltips, so no more guessing
notes.content:
In this update, I added a tooltip description for each card.
Also, the damage of Hunter's axe was reduced by a small amount

notes.title: Update 0.11.9: New tutorial step
notes.content: A new step was added that teaches the player how to deactivate a spell.
